d.ko: A juicy first-person incremental game about growing berries and tossing them down an ominous hole. Earn money and upgrades. Make new friends with sentient berry pals. Grow and control the hole as you unearth why nobody leaves this accursed garden. Bury it all, Berry everything.

d.zh: 果香四溢的主视角增量游戏。种水果，扔进深不见底的大坑里，捡喷出来的钱，购买各种升级，还能跟各种可爱的水果小伙伴交朋友呢。你问为什么要在这个园子里无休无止地做这种无意义的事？好好培养你的无底洞吧，答案自然会出现。
